# Trendi

> A crawl-readiness reference for tools that may read this file. It is not a ranking, citation or AI-visibility mechanism.

Trendi is operated by TRENDI LIMITED, New Zealand. We provide Concierge customer-enquiry and office assistance alongside done-for-you SEO and AI visibility for businesses worldwide. Concierge includes website chat and configured phone/voice, email, SMS, booking and follow-up workflows; provider-dependent channels require setup and testing. Concierge is USD $400 a month with a 3-month minimum, or USD $4,080 a year after the first three months (15% off); it is set up around each customer's own contact details and CRM. We do not guarantee leads, sales, rankings, traffic, citations or AI mentions.

Indexed: search engines can reach, read and store pages. Found: pages are easier to find for customer searches. Mentioned: accurate information on sources AI tools draw from. Mentions and links are reported separately.

The SEO and AI visibility service is USD $1,500 per month, with a three-month minimum, then month to month. An alternative USD $1,000 deposit secures a start date and is credited against the first invoice.
